technical_and_design_decisions: Target platform is the existing Spring XD codebase (spring-xd on GitHub); all changes reuse the existing Gradle build, module deployment infrastructure, and test harness rather than introducing new frameworks.

U1: Scala-based Spark streaming modules will be packaged as standard XD modules with the scala-library and Spark dependencies declared via the module's build file; deployment support will extend the existing module loader to resolve Scala classes and run Spark streaming receivers/processors inside XD containers.
U2: ulimit guidance (recommended 10K, plus the 'Too many open files' exception rationale) will be added as a new 'Troubleshooting' section in the project wiki (markdown), not in shipped code.
U3: The date will be added by changing the log conversion pattern in config/xd-container-logger.properties (e.g., adding an explicit date field to the pattern); no code changes required.

U4: Kafka test infrastructure will launch Zookeeper and Kafka Server as separate OS processes (via ProcessBuilder/Gradle task) that tests connect to over TCP, instead of embedding them in the test JVM.

U6: Tests will accept an external broker via system/environment properties (host/port), with a dedicated Gradle/CI profile so the broker is not provisioned by the build itself, reducing build memory footprint.
U5: publish-maven.gradle will load version values (Spring Boot, hadoop-common, etc.) from dependencies.properties and substitute them during POM generation, eliminating duplicated hardcoded versions.

U7: Sonar findings will be triaged into 'fix' vs. 'invalid/won't fix'; fixes follow existing code conventions with no API changes; irrelevant items are marked invalid in Sonar with justification comments.
U8: The Spark batch job sample will be implemented as a self-contained sample module (Java/Scala Spark job) with its own build file and README, deployable in an XD distributed setup.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD development toolchain (JDK, Gradle, CI, test infrastructure) is already installed and functional; no environment setup effort is included beyond the listed activities.

The specification's generic description of Spring Framework (including Java 17+ for Spring 6) is background only; the increment targets Spring XD, which builds with the project's existing JDK/toolchain.
Spark and Scala versions are fixed by the project's dependency management; no version-migration work is required.
An external Kafka broker and Zookeeper ensemble are available for U6 testing (locally or on a CI-accessible host).
A Sonar server with an existing violation report for the project is available; approximately 40-60 open violations must be triaged.
Estimates include design, implementation, unit/integration tests, documentation updates, and self-verification, performed by a single developer.
Effort is pure development work; it excludes elapsed-time factors such as waiting on external reviewers, CI queue delays, or meetings.
U2 wiki edits and U3 log-pattern change are configuration/documentation-only changes verified by manual inspection.
No clarifying questions are required; ambiguities are resolved using the reasonable interpretations stated in the technical decisions.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all eight user stories, inspect the affected code areas (module deployment, logging config, Kafka test harness, Gradle publish scripts), and produce the technical approach and task breakdown for the increment.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Design Scala/Spark streaming module deployment
activities.activity_description: Design how Scala-developed Spark streaming modules are packaged and deployed in XD: module packaging, scala-library dependency handling, classloading, and module registration.

activities.activity_name: U1 - Implement Scala/Spark streaming module deployment support
activities.activity_description: Implement the deployment support so a Spark streaming module written in Scala can be easily deployed: module loader changes, dependency resolution, and runtime wiring of the Spark streaming job in the XD container.
Write unit and integration tests for Scala Spark streaming module deployment, verify deployment of a sample Scala module end to end, and document the usage steps.

Create a new 'Troubleshooting' section in the project wiki documenting the recommended ulimit setting of 10K for XD distributed setups, including the 'Too many open files' FileNotFoundException as the exception rationale for increasing it.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Add date to container log output
activities.activity_description: Adjust the log conversion pattern in config/xd-container-logger.properties to include the date, rebuild, and verify that container logs now show day and time for troubleshooting.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Kafka tests with Kafka Server as a separate process
activities.activity_description: Refactor the Kafka test infrastructure to start Zookeeper and Kafka Server as separate running processes (Gradle task/ProcessBuilder), update affected tests to connect over TCP, and validate the improved build experience.

activities.activity_name: U6 - Kafka tests against an external broker
activities.activity_description: Add configuration (system properties, Gradle/CI profile) so Kafka tests can run against an externally provisioned broker, verify test suite passes, and confirm reduced memory/footprint of the build process.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Centralize dependency versions in publish-maven.gradle
activities.activity_description: Modify publish-maven.gradle to read dependency versions (e.g., Spring Boot, hadoop-common) from dependencies.properties and substitute them into generated POMs; verify generated POMs contain correct versions.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Sonar violation triage and cleanup
activities.activity_description: Review the current Sonar violations (~40-60 assumed), fix the relevant ones in code with appropriate tests, and mark the irrelevant ones as invalid/won't-fix with justification.

activities.activity_name: U8 - Implement Spark batch job sample
activities.activity_description: Develop a Spark batch job sample (job code, build configuration, packaging as an XD-deployable job) that demonstrates distributed data computation capabilities.
Verify the Spark batch job sample executes correctly in a distributed XD setup and write the sample README/usage documentation.
Integrate all changes on the main branch, run the full build and regression test suite (including refactored Kafka tests), fix integration fallout, and prepare the increment for delivery.
